description: Request a consultation with a Mirabello Consultancy specialist. Use only when the user asks to be contacted or to book. Requires email + programme interest/message and explicit consent. Side effect: delivers the enquiry to Mirabello and returns a tracked booking URL. Each call sends a separate enquiry, so do not repeat a call that succeeded.

consent.description: User consents to share details with Mirabello Consultancy (GDPR). Must be true to deliver.

email.description: Contact email address for the enquiry. Only ever send an address the user has explicitly provided for this purpose.

family_size.description: who is included (e.g. "single", "couple", "family of 4") — optional summary; prefer number_of_children + childrens_ages

goal.description: why / use-case (e.g. second passport, EU residency, tax, mobility, family relocation)

preferred_channel.description: how the client prefers to be contacted

programme_interest.description: programme or shortlist of interest (e.g. "st-kitts-cbi" or "CBI Caribbean", or service category: "Citizenship by Investment", "Residency by Investment", "Citizenship by Marriage", "Citizenship by Descent", "Passport Renewal", "Government Advisory")

residence_country.description: current country of residence (if different from nationality)

source.description: origin surface of this lead for attribution, e.g. "plan_path" when booking follows a plan_path result

name: book_consultation

outputSchema.description: Mirabello response envelope. Tool-specific fields vary; the provenance/disclaimer envelope is always present.

book_url.description: Link to request a consultation with a Mirabello specialist, for a personal case.

data_updated.description: Date the underlying dataset was last updated.

disclaimer.description: Information, not legal/tax/financial/immigration advice; figures indicative.

error.description: Present only when the request could not be fulfilled.

source.description: Attribution for the data, when it is not Mirabello Consultancy itself.

title: Book Consultation
